exp.desc:
- Weekend service for up to 300 guests
- Casual staff, complaints
- Wine list

cl.p1: on summer weekends we welcome up to 300 guests on the terrace. I seat them, organise the casual staff and deal with the complaints that are bound to come with so many people. I have been head waitress for three years, and I run the restaurant whenever the owner is away.
cl.p2: What I want to learn now is the commercial side: labour cost, food cost, pricing. I am taking a course in it at the moment, and a traditional inn with a good kitchen is exactly where I want to put it into practice.

cl.p1: five years running a fast-food restaurant with 45 staff taught me numbers, processes and people management. Now I want to return to full-service hospitality, where I started as a waiter.
cl.p2: I cut labour cost by four percentage points without hurting service and halved staff turnover by publishing rotas two weeks ahead. Your restaurant is seasonal with many casual staff, and planning for that is something I do well.

letters.label: Fast-food general manager returning to full service
